description: This file defines the SandboxTokenParser class used by Twig to parse and handle the 'sandbox' tag in templates. It marks sections of template code as untrusted that should be evaluated in sandbox mode, primarily containing logic to parse the sandbox block, enforce restrictions, and produce a SandboxNode.

classes.name: SandboxTokenParser
classes.description: A token parser class for handling 'sandbox' tags in Twig templates, responsible for parsing sandbox sections, enforcing restrictions, and creating sandbox nodes.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'sandbox' tag in a Twig template, validates its structure, and returns a SandboxNode.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines whether the current token indicates the end of the 'sandbox' block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this parser, which is 'sandbox'.
